friendInvite.title:
Invite friends and
collect paw prints
friendInvite.description: Send a link on KakaoTalk. Your friend gets {{inviteeDays}} days of Premium right when they join. You get {{inviterDays}} days of Premium and can add 1 more friend once they complete to-dos on {{activeDays}} different days

voiceSay.title:
Say everything
on your mind
voiceSay.description: No typing needed. Say several things at once.

voicePlan.title:
AI fills in dates
and repeats for you
voicePlan.description: Repeats, date ranges, times, sub-tasks, and "only me" are picked up and filled in.

voiceFacts.title:
Audio files never
leave for our servers
voiceFacts.description: Try it free {{freeCount}} times a month. If it fails, it doesn't count.
voiceFacts.ctaLabel: Speak to add from the new to-do sheet

previews.example: “<vitamins>Vitamins every morning at 8</vitamins>, <gym>gym Mon Wed Fri at 7 PM</gym>, <trip>business trip next Monday to Wednesday</trip>, <groceries>groceries: milk, eggs, tofu</groceries>, and <meeting>prep the team meeting Friday at 3, just for me</meeting>”

privacy.title: Audio files aren't sent to Aido servers
privacy.description: Only the text is used. If your device can't recognize speech itself, Apple or Google speech recognition may be used.

free.title: Free to try
free.description: Failed tries don't count. You'll see what's left next to the mic.

same.title: Just like to-dos you type
same.description: Reminders, repeats, and sub-tasks work the same.
